guards: Only reviewed USB endpoint literal; no arbitrary PID/endpoint/system-capture arguments.
All ZIP/receipt/source/provenance checks before nonce directory/Popen; no extraction of arbitrary paths.
Fresh cryptographic32hex nonce directory on exact D:/DordiaiTestTemp, no symlink/junction/any Windows reparse ancestor. Only verified own EXE copied.
Ready JSON schema strict, actual held Popen PID compared, GetProcessTimes reads held childHANDLE and reconstructs exact64bit FILETIME usingPythonint. No JS/float roundtrip or PID reopen.
Immediate ASCII permit nonce|pid|exactFILETIME|exeSHA plusLF on inherited stdin pipe; native1s permit window respected.
Parent8s watchdog and finite ownPopen.kill/wait/reap only, no taskkill tree or process enumeration. Bounded stdout/stderr readers preserve malformed-output failures.
Read-only IMMDevice default render-role snapshot before/after; external changes are reported as failures, never restored. No default/volume/session/device/registry setters.
Separate describe-only and run+reviewed native-format modes; new fresh nonce for each. Native clock/PCM source/identity/hash/session bounds reverified afterrun.

Full100ms marker stereoNCC and five ordinary20ms windows at one full-marker chosen offset. No independently selected window offsets, interpolation, time/framewarp, polarity flip or silence cherry-picking.

Two axes assessed independently: render IAudioClock position/frequency+QPC versus process-tap packet frame positions/QPC/flags. Zero positions stayzero; S_FALSE/TIMESTAMP_ERROR/discontinuity never promoted to precise readings.

local_tests.scope: No real child/exe/audio execution. Synthetic ZIP/hash/signature/staleness/unsafe members; exact FILETIME beyond2^53; fakePopen timeout/ownkill/reap/wrongready/malformedJSON; unchanged defaults bound; fullmarker/windowNCC; valid marker withzero render/capture clocks remains unaccepted.

root_next_commands_after_review.results: Each own nonceDdirectory keeps parent-report.json and verified own EXE; native run additionally reference.pcm, captured.pcm, clock.json. No pre-existing files are deleted.

limits: FakePopen tests prove controller error logic; actual held process handshake and native format/marker transport are not yet exercised locally.
Cold process startup/OS scheduling may consume deadline; rejected/timeout cases retain own output and kill/reap only ownchild. Native8s watchdog is independently present in pinned source.
Direct GetMixFormat describe opens an IAudioClient without Initialize/Start, so it is read-only endpoint interrogation, not an acoustic test.
Default snapshots detect observed role changes but cannot attribute them to the helper versus simultaneous external user activity. Controller never restores another actor’s changes.
NCC uses retained software PCM array offset, never measured or inferred physical latency. Render clock availability does not substitute for a missing capture device-position axis.
Artifact verification trusts root-supplied authenticated exact ZIP pins and recorded CI compiler signatures; the locally generated project EXE itself is not claimed Microsoft-signed.
No product/native pronunciation/realNVDA/physical audible onset/stop or targetP95/P99 acceptance is claimed.
